retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 15 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge, and it is eleven days old. The English article, at revision 1375772690, is an account of a killing on 10 September 2025 and of the reaction to it, and it names no event this atlas holds; the atlas's most recent American records are the Iraq war and the financial crisis, and nothing connects. A record this recent is also one whose article is being rewritten hourly, so a revision cited today is not the article a reader will open. The sweep's set 4 ranks by sitelinks and a story in the news accumulates them fast, which is how a row eleven days old came to be among the best remaining; that is worth knowing about the rule rather than working around.
